meta.name: broken-link-checker
meta.description: Scans a website to find broken links (404s, 500s). Crawls internal pages, identifies broken outbound links, and reports source pages for easy fixing. Use this when the user asks to "check for broken links", "find 404s", "audit my links", or "is my site healthy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描网站,找出失效链接并定位来源页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你运营网站,想确保所有链接都有效
copy.tagline_en: Scan your site and spot broken links with source pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a website and need to ensure all links work

howto.what: 扫描指定网站,抓取内部页面,找出返回 404 或 500 的坏链接(含失效外链),并报告坏链所在的来源页面,方便修复。
howto.when: 当用户要求“检查断链”、“查找 404”、“审查链接”等,或询问网站是否健康时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 https://example.com 有没有坏链
say.note: Claude 会开始扫描该网站并报告坏链来源。

say.text: 找出 example.com 上所有返回 404 的链接
say.note: 会列出每条坏链及它所在的页面。

say.text: 我的网站 example.com 健康吗?查一下死链
say.note: 触发对网站链接状态的完整审计。

howto.what_en: Scans a given website, crawls internal pages, identifies broken links returning 404 or 500 (including broken outbound links), and reports the source pages where each broken link appears for easy fixing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'check for broken links', 'find 404s', 'audit links', etc., or asks if the site is healthy.

say_en.note: Claude will scan the site and report broken link sources.
It lists each broken link and the page it appears on.

say_en.text: Is my site example.com healthy? Check for dead links
say_en.note: Triggers a full link audit for the site.
